content: PM-KISAN provides income support to eligible landholding farmer families. Eligible farmer families receive ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Commonly required information includes Aadhaar number, mobile number, bank account details and land-related information. Applicants should verify eligibility and complete the required registration and eKYC process through the official PM-KISAN portal.

Ayushman Bharat provides health coverage and cashless healthcare services to eligible beneficiaries at empanelled hospitals, subject to applicable scheme rules. For services under the Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY), beneficiaries should verify their eligibility and beneficiary status through the official government system. Depending on the service or verification process, commonly requested information may include Aadhaar or another accepted identity document and beneficiary or family details. Applicants and beneficiaries should verify the exact documents and requirements applicable to their case through the official National Health Authority portal before using the service.

Indian passport applications are processed through the official Passport Seva system. Applicants generally need identity proof, address proof and applicable date-of-birth or supporting documents. The process includes registration, selecting the required passport service, filling the application, paying the applicable fee, scheduling an appointment and visiting the designated centre when required. Application status can be tracked through the official Passport Seva portal.

PAN (Permanent Account Number) is issued by the Income Tax Department. Document requirements depend on the application method. For Instant e-PAN, an individual who has not already been allotted a PAN needs a valid Aadhaar number, a mobile number linked with Aadhaar, and access to DigiLocker. The Instant e-PAN process uses DigiLocker to obtain supporting proof of date of birth. For regular PAN applications, applicants may need documents serving as proof of identity, proof of address and proof of date of birth, depending on the applicant and application type. Applicants should verify the applicable document list and process on the official Income Tax Department portal before applying.

Driving licence services are provided through the official Parivahan system. Commonly required documents and information may include proof of identity, proof of address, proof of date of birth, a valid learner licence where applicable, passport-size photographs where required, and applicable medical or fitness documents depending on the applicant's age and type of licence. The process may include learner licence application, document submission, fee payment, appointment booking and driving test. Applicants should meet the applicable age and eligibility requirements and verify the exact document requirements through the official Parivahan portal before applying.

An income certificate provides official information about a person's or family's income and may be required for government services, benefits and applications. Applicants generally provide identity proof, address proof and income-related documents. The exact process and issuing authority may vary by state.

Government scholarships are available under different schemes with different eligibility conditions. Depending on the scholarship, academic performance, income, category, institution and other conditions may apply. Applicants generally need identity details, student or enrollment information, academic documents and bank account details. Requirements should be verified for the selected scholarship before applying.

Birth registration and birth certificates in India are handled through the official Civil Registration System and the relevant Registrar or local registration authority. The registration process records information such as the child's details, parents' details, address and place of birth. The exact documents and supporting requirements can vary depending on the State, Union Territory, registration authority and whether the birth is being registered normally or through delayed registration. Applicants should provide the required birth and family details and verify the exact document requirements with the concerned Registrar or official Civil Registration System before applying.
